fields.value: “Parental genomes segregate into distinct blastomeres during multipolar zygotic divisions leading to mixoploid and chimeric blastocysts” (GBIO-D-22-00145)

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Image files used to store microscopy live-imaging data of bovine embryos directly cleaving into 3-4 blastomeres.

The files named as following are Nikon NIS-Elements ND2 image file format (z stacks time-laps): 
VideoS2_3A.nd2
VideoS3_3B.nd2	
VideoS4_3C.nd2	
VideoS6_3E.nd2

The files named as following are Tiff format files (time laps of max projections of the two different channels for mCherry and eGFP)
Cam_Long_00000_PROJ_ch0
Cam_Long_00000_PROJ_ch1
Cam_Long_00001_PROJ_ch0
Cam_Long_00001_PROJ_ch1
etc.
